message.content: No, the drones in our fleet aren’t alike at all. They come in different models from different manufacturers, so they vary in how much they can carry, how far they can fly, and what sensors they have—like cameras, thermal cameras, or laser scanners. They also use different charging connectors, and those aren’t interchangeable, so a drone from one model can’t just plug into any charging pad. Each one has its own setup and rules for how it’s used.
